g.text: Unsplit throughput / policy-class throughput = policy latency / unsplit latency
0.5× = half the performance · 1× = no change · >1× = faster without splitting
Measured ablation of a hypothetical policy on seven displayed split-region shapes; each class is independently batch invariant.
Same operands, MMA primitive, and epilogue; each class uses its own default or autotuned configuration.
